svg.title: nvsnap on One Cluster
svg.desc: NVCA or another controller creates GPU pods; the Kubernetes API sends each to the nvsnap webhook, which the agent on every GPU node serves. The agent captures and restores pods on its node, keeps checkpoints on the node's disk, registers them in the server's catalog, copies them to an L2 volume pair in cluster storage, and serves them to other nodes' agents. Model volumes hold one copy of each model for the cluster. An object-store bucket shared between clusters is optional.
svg.text: One agent per GPU node; one server per cluster. Dashed: optional.
NVCA deploys an NVCF function's pods; nvsnap does not author their specs. 2 The webhook prepares each pod it covers: the node bundle, gpushare, the model landing, or a restore placeholder.
The agent captures a warm pod, or restores a placeholder, on its node; 4 the bundle it staged is mounted read-only in the pods it prepares.
Every checkpoint is registered in the catalog with its sources; its capture record carries its tenant scope. 6 After a capture the checkpoint is copied in the background to the L2 pair. 7
Agents fetch checkpoints from each other over HTTP, and every node that fetches becomes a source. 8 Cross-cluster replication through a bucket is opt-in.
